title: Perfectness and cobase stability of coherent right-cone equivalences
statement: Use simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. For a small simplicial category $A$, write $\pi_0A$ for the category with the same objects and the path components of its mapping simplicial sets as morphisms. Call $u:U\to V$ a categorical equivalence when $\mathfrak C[u]$ induces weak homotopy equivalences on all mapping simplicial sets and an equivalence of the categories $\pi_0\mathfrak C[U]\to\pi_0\mathfrak C[V]$. Fix a small simplicial set $S$ in a universe enlarged if necessary. For $a:X\to S$, put $C_S(a)=S\amalg_X(X\star\Delta^0)$, where $(X\star\Delta^0)_r=X_r\amalg\{v_r\}\amalg\coprod_{0\leq u<r}X_u$ has the ordered-concatenation operators: a simplex in $X_u$ has its first $u+1$ vertices in $X$ and the remaining vertices at $v$, and restriction or repetition of vertices uses the corresponding operator on the surviving $X$ block, with an empty $X$ block giving $v_r$; a map $f:(X,a)\to(Y,b)$ over $S$ induces $C_S(f):C_S(a)\to C_S(b)$. Let $W_S$ be the class of maps $f$ over $S$ for which $C_S(f)$ is a categorical equivalence. Then $W_S$ contains all isomorphisms and satisfies two-out-of-three. It is closed under small filtered colimits in the arrow category of $\mathrm{sSet}_{/S}$, and there is a small set $W_{S,0}\subseteq W_S$ such that every member of $W_S$ is isomorphic to a small filtered colimit of members of $W_{S,0}$. Here filtered means that every finite diagram, including the empty one, has a cocone; arrows in the arrow category are commuting squares and colimits are computed on both endpoints. Moreover, in a pushout square $X\xrightarrow{f}Y$, $X\xrightarrow{i}X'$, $Y\to Y'$, $X'\xrightarrow{f'}Y'$ over $S$, if $f\in W_S$ and $i$ is degreewise injective, then $f'\in W_S$. These assertions hold in each input universe. No quasicategory hypothesis on $S$ is imposed.
